prompt: The client wants to know why profit fell from 2023 to 2025. Which takeaway matters most?

exhibit.title: Revenue and cost of goods sold ($M)

options.text: Cost of goods sold grew faster than revenue
options.feedback: Right. COGS rose 25% (120 to 150) against 10% revenue growth (200 to 220), so gross profit fell from 80 to 70.
True, but it doesn't answer the client's question.

options.text: Cost of goods sold fell over the period
options.feedback: That misreads the chart: COGS rose from 120 to 150.

options.text: A new supplier contract caused the cost increase
options.feedback: The chart doesn't show this. It may be true, but there is no data here to support it.

explanation: Cost of goods sold grew faster than revenue. COGS rose 25% (120 to 150) against 10% revenue growth (200 to 220), so gross profit fell from 80 to 70.

extras.proof: COGS rose 25% (120 to 150) against 10% revenue growth (200 to 220), so gross profit fell from 80 to 70.
